title: Door & Window Alarm 110 dB – Wireless Remote Control
seo_title: Window & Door Alarm 110 dB with Remote Control
seo_description: 110 dB vibration alarm for a door, window or bike. Switch it on and off with the wireless remote – without walking over to it.
descriptionHtml:
The door you never hear

The patio door at the back, the basement window that's left ajar, the bike you park outside the front door — you know someone could open or tug at them without you noticing until afterwards.

An alarm that notices what you miss

Put the alarm on the door, window or bike. A vibration sensor detects when something touches it, and 110 dB can be heard throughout the house. The remote switches the alarm on and off from a distance, so you don't have to creep over to the window every time you come and go.

Features

  • 110 dB is heard throughout the house – the sound level is on par with a chainsaw at close range.
  • Switch the alarm off without walking over – the wireless remote turns it on and off from a distance.
  • No app, no subscription, no electrician – one unit and one remote are enough, for the door, window or bike.
  • Sounds when someone tugs or pries, not only once it's open – the vibration sensor picks up movement in the door, window or bike.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.
